item.title: Home
item.description:
Hello, I'm Adrián.

Engineer, builder, leader

I write about engineering economics, AI in real teams, and the human systems that make delivery work.

I'm VP of Technology at Worksome, leading Product, Engineering, and Design. Before that, I was VP of Engineering at SumUp.

Nearly two decades across Spain, the Netherlands and Denmark: IC, founder, CTO, VP. Download my CV · Work with me
